//: Registration examples for the Loom MCP servers, split by blast radius. Copy the entry you need into your client's .mcp.json (Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf). Build first: see apps/loom-mcp/README.md. Replace LOOM_TOKEN with a loom_pat_<id>_<secret> from Settings -> Developer -> API tokens, and LOOM_API_URL with your estate. Do NOT commit a real token. M3 loom-author is WRITE (dry-run by default; needs read-write scope). M5 loom-admin is ADMIN (default-OFF, never accepts a PAT — sign in with the loom CLI; enable with LOOM_MCP_ADMIN_ENABLED=1).
